inspectorLines: Hmm. Valid until 08:59:59. It is now 08:59:58.
So you are technically on time. 'Technically' — the saddest word in any language.
Look around. Everyone on this platform has your face. Did you notice?
Go on. Your inbox has been waiting for you since 3 a.m.
Have a productive day. That is not a wish. It is a requirement.

flat.hint: A / D to walk · E to interact · the door is on the right

mirror: One more day. You've got this. Probably.
plant: At least someone here is growing.
The plant forgives me. For now.
cat: Purr. The only one who needs nothing from me.
The cat approves of my burnout.
Five more minutes? The cat agrees.

intro.beggarPrompt: E — listen to the old tanuki
beggarLines: I am freer than you are.
No boss. No inbox. No deadline. Just the blossoms.
You run every morning. I sit. Who is winning?
Spare a minute? Not yen — a minute. You don't have one, do you?
My calendar is completely empty. Envy me.
The petals fall whether you are on time or not.
I used to have a corner office. Now I have the whole corner.

email.subject: Subject: RE: RE: FW: URGENT!!! quick sync
email.body: Per my last email, everything is now a priority. Please action ASAP.

office.waveStart: The office has turned against you!
office.minibossDown: {name} is down! The others are getting angry…
office.bossIncoming: The CEO has entered the building. "We're a family!"
office.bossDown: The CEO is down. The lift is open.
office.weaponBlocked: Stuck in a meeting — can't attack!

bestie: Come on, let's go grab a coffee and go for a walk
You didn't hear this from me, but I have some tea.
I have three things to tell you, and none of them are work-related.
Meet me in the kitchen in five. It's important.
baker: I baked fresh warm cookies/scones! Take two!
I can't fix your deadlines, but I can offer you a cookie!
Tough day? I think I have just the thing for that.
expert: Ticket no12085? Already found the bug, MR's done, too
Here, let me run that script for you real quick.
I've dealt with this before, let me show you a little trick!
Trust me, I've made that mistake at least twice.
meeting_saver: I think we've covered everything, so let's give everyone 15 minutes back!
This sounds like something we can solve in a quick email.
Before we schedule another meeting, how about we just make a decision?
Let's wrap this up before someone suggests a follow-up meeting.
shouter: WHERE ARE THOSE Q3 REPORT NUMBERS?! I NEED THEM 5 MINUTES AGO!
I DON'T CARE ABOUT EXCUSES, I CARE ABOUT KPI ALIGNMENT!
LET'S DO A QUICK TRUST-FALL EXERCISE RIGHT NOW! REMEMBER: TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK! SMILE!
THIS IS A TOP PRIORITY! JUST LIKE THE OTHER FIVE!
karen: Must be nice having time to just walk around like that. If you're this free I have a report I need help with...
I know it’s Friday 4:55 PM, but the board just saw the project and we need to completely pivot the entire concept. Can you send over a fresh draft by tomorrow morning? Thanks, super urgent!
I didn't actually read your last three emails, but I went ahead and scheduled a 90-minute quick alignment call with 12 people during your lunch break!
I've noticed some people have been taking longer lunch breaks lately.
lazy: Oh, was this report due yesterday? Pretty sure you were handling it.
Did you submit a Jira ticket for this issue? Not my department
Have you tried turning it off and on again?
Oh, you need help with that task that was assigned to me 2 months ago? Man, I would LOOOVE to help, but my plate is completely overflowing right now. Let's touch base next quarter!
photos: Wait, don't walk away yet! You HAVE to see this 4-minute video of Mr. Whiskers trying to catch his own tail. I actually made an Instagram account for him, he has 42 followers now! Do you want to see his medical history photos too?
Wait, don't leave! Look at this clip of Theodore chasing a laser! Custest thing ever!!
Oh, that reminds me of something my dog did! Let me find the photo.
Hold on, let me show you our entire vacation album!
hobby: So anyway, for my sourdough starter, I use a 70% hydration ratio...
You won't believe what happened at the local stamp collectors' meetup!
I spent the whole weekend alphabetizing my tea collection!
I've started tracking my daily step count in three different apps!

ceo: I can't give more budget for this scope, but I do have extra tasks and high expectations! Let's make magic happen! By yesterday btw
WE'RE NOT JUST A COMPANY. WE'RE A FAMILY! AND FAMILY DOESN'T CLOCK OUT!
YOUR RESISTANCE SHOWS GREAT INITIATIVE! I'M ADDING IT TO YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES!
YOUR BURNOUT IS JUST PASSION LEAVING YOUR BODY!
THERE'S NO SUCH THING AS OVERWORKED. ONLY UNDERMOTIVATED!
client: This could have been an email... but let's schedule a 2-hour call for Friday 3pm
Hey, so I was thinking about just a small tweak.. Can we make the logo bigger and change everything last minute?
Loved the design! Just a quick feedback: can we make it feel more 'premium' yet 'approachable'? Also, change all the colors, remove the main feature, and make the logo 300% bigger!
I've sent over some feedback. It's all in the 36-page PDF.

I'm going to sell handmade mochi at the market.
